description: Source code for ALSA-based audio sink implementation, including class definitions, thread management, and audio data handling functions.

classes.name: AlsaAudioSink
classes.description: Implements an ALSA-based audio sink that pulls data from a source and writes to ALSA device, managing playback in a dedicated thread.

classes.name: AlsaAudioSinkType
classes.description: Defines the type for creating ALSA audio sink instances, managing their lifecycle.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of AlsaAudioSink with specified parameters.

methods.name: IsType
methods.description: Checks if the given type matches the instance's type.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the audio sink.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the audio sink.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the audio sink has a valid playback handle.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Static thread entry point that starts the audio processing loop.

methods.name: AudioThreadFunc
methods.description: Main function for the audio processing thread, manages idle and playback loops.

methods.name: IdleLoop
methods.description: Handles waiting when no data is available or playback is paused, writes silence as needed.

methods.name: PlaybackLoop
methods.description: Handles pulling frames from source and writing to ALSA device, manages underflow and rate adjustments.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Helper to write audio frames to ALSA, handles resampling if playback rate differs from 1.0.
